title: Passo del Vivione to Rifugio Curo
terrain: 21.9km, 1385m D+, 1315m D-, high traverse between 1810m and 2615m

steps.target: Z1-Z2, run the climbs and flats, HIKE the steep descents

coachNotes: Biggest session of the block and level with Resegone on descent (1315m against 1319m), so no new single-day eccentric maximum. That flat peak is the argument that makes this week defensible against the 20% ramp flag. Saturday's descent is discretionary, Sunday's is your exit from the valley and is not, so spend today's cheaply: run every climb and every flat, then deliberately power-hike anything steep or technical down to Curo. You lose no training value and arrive Sunday with quads that can still absorb a 24% gradient. Cap average HR at 150 across the day; the watch is set to alert above 88% LTHR (158bpm) with the low bound dropped to 55% so it never beeps on a descent. Garmin target 270-310. Full autonomy on water and food above 2000m.
